family.description: Exploratory pilot of issue bfc2ceab, protocol version 4: this addendum is the pilot and every cell is exploratory. Question: what does a caller of a shipped consumer pay when the caller-trusted safe entry points of gf2-kernels-simd check their conditions in release builds? Both arms are the one arm package entry-check-arm built twice from one tree with the same profile and features: the baseline with no flag, the candidate with RUSTFLAGS `--cfg gf2_entry_checked`, under which each affected detection function of the kernel crate publishes its checked wrapper instead of the wrapper it publishes today. The arms differ in that cfg alone; the plan records each arm's RUSTFLAGS and executable digest, and each execution reports the entry-point form its build publishes, observed from the linked kernel crate's behaviour on a probe panel and refused when it disagrees with the plan. The checked wrapper is the form the issue would ship by deleting the gate: a named release assertion ahead of the same unsafe kernel call, hoisted out of every kernel loop. Every cell is whole-consumer: the timed call is the public consumer on operands in the representation a caller holds, so packing, dispatch, the kernel and the output are inside it and no conversion stands outside. What each cell's check is: spmm-small-n16 (per row): one column scan per sparse row, against one 16-column block per non-zero; spmm-small-n1024 (per row): one column scan per sparse row, amortized over 64 blocks per non-zero; spmm-medium-n16 (per row): the same scan on the u16 lane; spmm-medium-n1024 (per row): the same scan on the u16 lane, amortized; permanent-f3-n14 (per kernel call): one length check per kernel call, and the consumer makes one call per Gray step; ple-small-n128 (per panel): one shape check and one scan of the window entries per panel; ple-medium-n128 (per panel): the same panel check on the u16 lane; gemm-small-n32 (per row): one checked shape product per row of the product, which the byte-lane route sends through the row kernel; gemm-medium-n32 (per whole product): three checked shape products per product call, which the u16 panel route makes once. Every cell is single-core and warm: the consumers run on the calling thread in this build, and the check's cost is a per-call or per-row instruction cost that a cache-resident operand exposes most. Frozen confirmation selection: a first confirmatory attempt spends alpha/2 = 0.025, and P-20's tail-support bound, 10000 * (0.025 / m) / 2 >= 20, admits m = 6 confirmatory comparisons, so the confirmation retains spmm-small-n16, spmm-medium-n16, permanent-f3-n14, ple-small-n128, gemm-small-n32, gemm-medium-n32, one cell per check grain of each cost class, and drops spmm-small-n1024 and spmm-medium-n1024, whose amortized regime is the favourable end of the row scan that the 16-column cells carry at its least favourable, and ple-medium-n128, whose panel check has the form of ple-small-n128; the dropped cells keep their pilot evidence. The dense class is measured at both of its grains: gemm-small-n32 per row and gemm-medium-n32 per whole product. Frozen decision rule: the checked form of a cost class is recorded as an accepted measured cost when every confirmatory cell of the class records pass; a class with a cell that records fail or inconclusive goes back to the invoker with the measured ratio, as the choice between the check and an unchecked form of that interface. The rule reads the acceptance summary's recorded outcomes and nothing else.

effect.rationale: A check cannot make a consumer faster, so no cell is expected to record improved; the schema requires the threshold of every non-regression family. Ten percent is the smallest apparent gain that would need an explanation other than the check, such as a layout effect of the second build, before the family's numbers were read as the check's cost.
effect.equivalence_rationale: The checked form removes undefined behaviour from safe entry points, and the caller pays for it on every call. Five percent of a whole consumer call is the largest slowdown this family records as an accepted cost: below it a consumer's throughput budget is unchanged at the precision such budgets are stated, and above it the invoker decides between the check and an unchecked form of that interface. The confirmation freezes a pilot-derived resolution strictly below this margin.
effect.material_gap_rationale: No cell is a comparator-gap cell: every cell compares two builds of one gf2 consumer, so no material-gap threshold applies.

complexity_budget.maintenance_rationale: Adoption deletes the cfg gate and the unchecked wrappers and keeps the shared assertion module, one checked wrapper per entry point and the contract test. Three hundred lines is the ceiling for that production source, and no new unsafe kernel is allowed: the checked wrappers call the kernels that exist.
